description: This file contains the implementation of DES encryption algorithms, including key setup, encryption, decryption, and modes like ECB and CBC, with internal constants and functions for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: DES_set_key
methods.description: Initializes the key schedule from a DES key, setting up subkeys for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: DES_set_key_unchecked
methods.description: Deprecated wrapper for DES_set_key, sets up key schedule without parity checks.

methods.name: DES_encrypt1
methods.description: Performs DES encryption or decryption on a data block, with initial and final permutations.

methods.name: DES_encrypt2
methods.description: Performs DES encryption or decryption with optimized rotations, on a data block.

methods.name: DES_encrypt3
methods.description: Performs 3DES encryption on a data block using three key schedules.

methods.name: DES_decrypt3
methods.description: Performs 3DES decryption on a data block using three key schedules.

methods.name: DES_ecb_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a single block in ECB mode.

methods.name: DES_ncbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption or decryption on data.

methods.name: DES_ecb3_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a block with 3DES in ECB mode.

methods.name: DES_ede3_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs 3DES CBC mode encryption or decryption.

methods.name: DES_ede2_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs 2-key 3DES CBC mode encryption or decryption.

methods.name: DES_set_odd_parity
methods.description: Sets the DES key bytes to have odd parity.
